facts.business: Anuroop Packaging Limited manufactures corrugated packaging solutions including corrugated boxes, liners, sheets, and kraft rolls for diverse industries such as pharmaceuticals, logistics, stationery, ready-made garments, and FMCG.

capacity_or_capex.item: Evaluation of sale/disposal of Wada undertaking and acquisition of new machinery and factory premises
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Subject to shareholders' approval and requisite approvals

guidance_or_targets.statement: Company intends to remain responsive to emerging opportunities and may explore expansion through forward or backward integration, acquisition, or entry into other lines of business for diversification and long-term growth
guidance_or_targets.by_when: Ongoing, subject to commercial viability and approvals

key_risks: Location-specific labour availability and transportation/logistics constraints at Wada facility
Dependence on existing manufacturing footprint under evaluation for disposal
Uncertainty regarding future growth platform and capital allocation
